Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2D pixel-art animation source sheet for RagRPG, Diabrete, EAST only. Input 1 gives the exact established creature design. Input 2 is style and game scale only, DO NOT copy its identity or direction. Same creature as the attached south sheet; redraw as a true east view, do not mirror or recolor it. Every one of the sixteen poses is true EAST rightward profile, nose, muzzle, shoulders and feet all point to the RIGHT. One eye only when eyes are open, one side of the chest visible, opposite shoulder mostly behind the body. Preserve its exact red skin, ears, big dark hair, curved horns, short dark skirt, hand bands, and slim pointed tail. Creature: a small wiry imp familiar about half as tall as the warlock, dark carmine skin, tiny curved horns, large pointed ears, bile-yellow eyes, a fine tail with pointed tip, faint ember cracks on the shoulders, a small iron brand like the warlock's contract scars on his neck and a mischievous grin; ink-black, carmine, bile-yellow and ember-orange. Anatomy: two slender arms with clawed hands, two legs and exactly one tail; no wings; final pose fallen whole.  Row 3 attack in sequence: prepare to throw with one hand, rotate the shoulder with arm cocked, extend that arm in an overhand throw, relax into recovery; the hand is empty and no projectile.

Fit each whole silhouette inside a centered 235×235 px region per cell, foreshortening wide poses where needed. Constant ground anchor and drawing scale within the view and consistent proportions with front identity sheet. Four idle phases, four alternate walking phases, four attacks below, then two flinch poses, a compact collapse and a compact fully fallen pose, whole body kept tucked or broken apart as specified below. Match in-game crisply painted chibi pixel art, clean dark contours, strongly readable deliberate 2–3 tone shading. Empty real transparent cutout backdrop, no added base, foreground, cast shadow, grid or letters. Original designs. No particles, spells off the body, gore, projectile or floor.
